annotations.title: Propose inviting someone to a team

description: A proposal to invite a person to one of the signed-in person's teams (teamKey) by name and email, with an optional role. Once confirmed, the invitee receives an email; their skill ratings are theirs to set later. Stores a proposal only. Nothing happens until the person confirms it on welance.com/directory; the result includes the review link.

summary.description: One sentence, in the conversation language, saying what happens on confirm.
